method: every frame of the declared swap chain in [trace start + 10 s, + 190 s), with no missing rows; fps = frames x 1000 / total frame time; nearest-rank p99; no outlier removal; met only if every run and the pooled frames meet fps >= 30 and p99 <= 33.3 ms, with at least three valid runs of one build; optional vram_peak_mb must be positive and finite; vram_risk flags peaks above 7168 MB without changing the verdict; this input contract previously ignored vram_peak_mb (including 0); no committed run carried that key before this change. Runs of different features and fixtures are judged separately; wj is a gate and label scene requiring a fixture, immediate pose revision adoption and a passing pose check listing exactly all revisions drawn in the inclusive trace-start to trace-stop capture; w3f is an attribution scene for H-06 costs and never gate evidence
